scope: External means not resolved to a module or namespace in this scanned import root. Names include standard-library and third-party imports; they are not distribution names or installation requirements. Routes follow explicit local edges only and do not establish execution. Conditions, function bodies, dynamic targets, implicit package startup and installed packages are not simulated. Absence of a route does not prove an import unused. Review issues, cycles, dynamic calls and skips.
collection_scope: Complete means collection finished within the stated budgets, not that runtime imports are known. Hidden and conventional dependency directories, symlinks and nonregular files are skipped. Explicit AST imports only; parse issues and dynamic calls remain visible. Use a stable source tree. These are input-size limits, not CPU, memory or elapsed-time guarantees.
